cms.pagesIntro: Choose a page to edit. Its status shows whether visitors can see it.
cms.pagesHelp: Open a page to update its English and Bangla text, preview it, and follow the publishing steps.
cms.newPageHelp: For a new page, enter a short unique key and content in both languages. It starts as a draft.
cms.teamPageHelp: Need a staff profiles page? Create its draft here, then add a Staff profile section for each person.
cms.editorIntro: Edit both languages and preview before publication.
cms.editorSteps: Step 1: edit the text. Step 2: save a new revision. Step 3: a different reviewer approves it. Step 4: a different publisher publishes it.
cms.previewHelp: Preview shows the last saved revision. Save your changes before opening it.
cms.slugHelp: Use short lowercase words with hyphens, for example about-us.
cms.navigationIntro: Published core pages appear on the website automatically.
cms.navigationHelp: Extra menu links you have added appear below. Core page links are already visible on the public site.
cms.addNavigationHelp: Choose a published page and write its menu label in both languages.
cms.mediaIntro: Upload approved files for use in page content.
cms.seoIntro: See published search titles and add page redirects.
cms.settingsIntro: Choose a setting, review its current value, and save a change.
cms.settingsHelp: Your change is saved immediately. Page publishing still has its own review steps.
cms.robotsHelp: Search visibility also requires public indexing to be enabled in the site deployment.
cms.pageKeyHelp: Use a short key made of lowercase letters and hyphens, for example about or team.
cms.title: Title
cms.heading: Heading
cms.profileHelp: Add a person's approved name, role, and short bio. Enter only a non-sensitive approval reference below. Publish only with permission.
cms.error: The action could not be completed.

cms.error_INVALID_PAGE: Check the page key and both language fields, then try again.
cms.error_INVALID_REVISION: Check both language fields, then try saving again.
cms.error_PAGE_KEY_IN_USE: That page key is already used. Choose another.
cms.error_REVISION_CONFLICT: Someone saved a newer version. Reload the page before editing.
cms.error_SELF_REVIEW_DENIED: A different person must review this revision.
cms.error_APPROVAL_REQUIRED: A different reviewer must approve the latest revision before a different publisher can publish it.
cms.error_LOCALE_INCOMPLETE: Complete the title, page path, description, search fields and at least one section in both languages.
cms.error_MEDIA_NOT_PUBLIC: A section uses a media file that has not been approved for public use.
cms.error_SLUG_IN_USE: That page path is already in use.
cms.error_INVALID_NAVIGATION: Choose a published page and enter labels in both languages.
cms.error_NAVIGATION_CONFLICT: This menu position is already used. Choose another order number.
cms.error_PAGE_NOT_PUBLISHED: Publish the page before adding it to the menu.
cms.reviewRequired: A different reviewer must approve before another publisher can publish.
